questions.question: Any missing data may be suitably assumed 1(a) Differentiate between: (i) Constraint surface and composite constraint surface. (ii) Linear and non-linear programming problems. (04) (b) A two bar truss is to be designed to carry a load of 2W as shown in Fig.1. Both bars have a tubular section with mean diameter d and wall thickness t. The material of the bars has Young’s modulus E, and yield stress σy. The design problem involves the determination of the values of d and t so that the weight of the truss is a minimum, and neither yielding nor buckling occurs in any of the bars. Formulate the problem as a nonlinear programming problem. (06) 2(a) The profit per acre of a firm is given by 20 × 1 + 26 × 2 +4 × 1 × 2 - 4 × 12 -3 × 22 where x1 and x2 denote respectively the labour cost and the fertilizer cost. Find the values of x1 and x2 to maximize the profit. (04) (b) Find the solution for the following linear problem by using Lagrange multipliers: Minimize f = 2 × 1 - 3 × 2, subject to x1 + x2 ≤ 1; -2 × 1 + x2 ≥ 2; x1, x2 ≥ 0. (06) 3(a) Briefly explain the principle of cubic interpolation method for one dimensional optimization technique. (04) (b) Solve the following LP problem by simplex method. Minimize f = -3 × 1 - 2 × 2, subject to x1 - x2 ≤ 1; 3 × 1 - 2 × 2 ≤ 6; x1, x2 ≥ 0. (06) 4(a) Explain the steepest descent method of unconstrained minimization technique. (04) (b) For the function f(x) = 7 × 2 - 20x + 22, using Golden section method, find the minimum within an accuracy of 0.01. Carry out atleast four iterations. (06) 5(a) Discuss interior penalty function method with respect to constrained optimization technique. (04) (b) Minimize f(X) = x1 - x2 + 2 × 12 + 2 × 1 × 2 + x22 starting from the point X1 = {0, 0}T. Use Fletcher - Reeves method. Carry out atleast two iterations. (06) 6(a) Write short note on reflection process in the simplex method. (04) (b) What is a fitness function in genetic algorithms?
